_comment: EXAMPLE FILE -- fictional candidate 'Jordan Doe'. This shows the shape of resume_template.json: a bank of tagged, id'd bullets that the tailoring drafter (jobhunt/tailor/drafter.py) may SELECT FROM but never invent beyond. That constraint -- select an existing id, never write new bullet text -- is the anti-fabrication guardrail, and it's enforced in code (see _validate_no_fabrication in drafter.py), not just requested in the prompt. Copy this to resume_template.json and replace every field with your own real, factual experience. Projects live in projects.json and the cover-letter voice in voice_bank.json (see the .example files beside this one); jobhunt/profile_load.py merges the three.
